workflow.filter: Provisional filter: retain only as a flagged, lower-priority candidate for follow-up rather than treating it as stability-improving. This is a qualitative smoke-test decision, not a prediction of a measured stability delta.
workflow.rank: With only one candidate, I3A ranks first by default within this one-item smoke set. As a modest provisional stability-domain prioritization, it receives low/guarded priority because BLOSUM62 and ESM-2 both disfavor A relative to I at position 3, while the toy PSSM points the same way but carries no biological evidentiary weight.
